name: expo-template
description: A minimal Expo (React Native) template for Android app generation and web preview in the current product flow. It uses Expo SDK 54, Expo Router for file-based routing, NativeWind for styling, and pnpm only. It includes a basic project structure. Suitable as the default Android/mobile template when the user does not specify a stack. Key directories: app/ (routes and screens), components/, constants/, hooks/. Do not modify files outside these unless necessary.
